prerequisites: Fundamentals of calculus and mathematical analysis.
Principles of linear algebra and analytical geometry.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the basic notions of computer architecture, information representation, algorithms and programs.
Acquire the programming methodology for building programs in programming languages.
Acquire the basic notions of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the Matlab programming environment.
If-then-else control structures and algorithms with loops.
Main operations with arrays and matrices.
Files in Matlab, custom scripts and functions, data import and export.
Logical and relational operators, loops and conditional statements in Matlab.
Fundamentals of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

assessment_methods.method: Exam with multiple-choice questions on course topics (for odd enrollment numbers)
Matlab/Python programming exercise (for odd enrollment numbers)
Written exam with multiple-choice questions (for even enrollment numbers)
Open-ended question requiring algorithm design and implementation (for even enrollment numbers)

assessment_rules: The exam type for students with odd enrollment numbers is written and separate oral. For odd enrollment numbers, the assessment consists of multiple-choice questions on course topics and a Matlab/Python programming exercise. For even enrollment numbers, the exam consists of a written test with 14 multiple-choice questions and an open-ended question requiring the design of an algorithm for problem solving and its implementation in one of the programming languages presented during the course.
